results.title: Stanley Menzo appointed Kotoko head coach
results.content: The decision comes after Kotoko went four consecutive league matches without a win. The Porcupine Warriors currently sit 11th in the league table, with 14 points from 11 matches.

results.title: Wassa group demands 10% mining equity, 2% mineral sales revenue in Takwa mines
results.content: The Wassa Professionals Network (WPN) is urging the government to reserve a 10% equity stake and 2% of gross mineral sales revenue for host communities in future mining lease agreements within the Wassa enclave.

results.title: GPL: Hearts of Oak’s Kelvin Osei Asibey crowned Player of the Month for October
results.content: The defender played a pivotal role in Hearts of Oak's unbeaten run during the month, helping the Phobians secure four consecutive clean sheets in their four matches.

results.title: Korle Bu schedules admission for 5-year-old boy with brain tumour after JoyNews report on surgery delay
results.content: The Korle Bu Teaching Hospital has scheduled the admission of a five-year-old boy awaiting surgery for a brain tumour after JoyNews highlighted delays in his treatment despite the payment of GH¢77,561.

results.title: GPL: Hearts of Oak’s Nebojsa Kapor wins Coach of the Month for October
results.content: The Phobians played four matches in October, recording three wins and one draw without suffering a defeat. They scored three goals and kept four clean sheets, conceding no goals throughout the month.

results.title: Floyd Mayweather Jr arrives in Ghana, looks forward to working with Sharaf Mahama
results.content: The American arrived at the Accra International Airport on Wednesday afternoon on the invitation of businessman Nana Kwame Bediako.

results.title: Photos: MTN Ghana marks 30 years of service with stakeholder dinner
results.content: Telecommunications giant MTN Ghana has marked its 30th anniversary with a stakeholder dinner in Accra, celebrating three decades of connecting people, businesses and communities and contributing to Ghana’s digital and socio-economic development.

results.title: Today’s front pages: Thursday, November 19, 2026
results.content: Myjoyonline.com brings you the front pages of the various newspapers across the country.

results.title: Amputee World Cup: Black Challenge cruise past USA to reach quarter-finals
results.content: After a slow start to the tournament, the Black Challenge headed into the encounter with renewed confidence following their emphatic 6-0 victory over Iraq in their final Group D fixture.

results.title: Togo introduces 20% depreciation on customs value of used vehicles
results.content: Togolese authorities have introduced a temporary 20% depreciation on the customs value of used vehicles aged over five years that are currently held under customs control, in a move to facilitate clearance and ease congestion at vehicle storage lots.

results.title: GH¢77,561 paid for 5-year-old boy’s brain tumour surgery, but Korle bu has no bed after 3 months
results.content: A five-year-old boy whose family received public support through the Multimedia Group to raise funds for tumour surgery is still awaiting treatment at the Korle Bu Teaching Hospital after the facility reportedly failed to provide a bed for the procedure.

results.title: Sports Fund to be launched December 10
results.content: The Ghana Sports Fund is set to be officially launched on December 10, 2026 at the University of Professional Studies, Accra (UPSA), following a stakeholder engagement involving key players in the country’s sports sector.

results.title: Avatime chiefs lament frequent accidents on Ho-Fume road and call for redesign
results.content: The Avatime Traditional Authorities in the Ho West District of the Volta Region have lamented the frequent accidents on the Ho-Fume Road, which traverses mountainous terrain. results.title: Absa employees promote financial inclusion through Makola Market outreach
results.content: Over 100 women traders at Makola Market have benefited from a financial literacy outreach led by Absa Bank Ghana employees as part of the bank's Colleague Volunteerism programme, a key pillar of its Force for Good commitment.

results.title: ADB announces GH¢1.4m ultimate prizes for 2026 National Best Farmer and Fisher
results.content: Agricultural Development Bank PLC (ADB) has reaffirmed its longstanding commitment to Ghana’s agricultural transformation with the announcement of its headline sponsorship package for the 2026 National Farmers’ Day celebrations.

results.content: The Institute of Statistical, Social and Economic Research (ISSER) is urging government to strengthen oversight of public expenditure and prioritise investments in sectors capable of generating sustainable jobs as it implements the 2027 Budget. results.title: Mobile money transactions hit GH¢4.9tn in first 10 months – BoG
results.content: Mobile money transactions totalled GH¢4.9 trillion between January and October 2026, according to the Bank of Ghana (BoG)’s latest Economic and Financial Data.

results.title: Minerals Commission, CalBank sign GH¢1bn financing partnership to empower indigenous businesses in mining sector
results.content: The Minerals Commission and CalBank have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) aimed at strengthening indigenous participation and expanding access to financing opportunities across Ghana’s mining value chain. results.content: The Minister for Trade, Agribusiness and Industry, Elizabeth Ofosu-Adjare, has challenged Ghanaian businesses to expand their operations by introducing additional shifts to make the government’s 24-hour economy policy a reality. results.title: Mahama urges Ghanaian businesses to take advantage of $10bn New Economy Programme
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has urged Ghanaian businesses to position themselves to benefit from the government’s $10 billion New Economy Programme, warning against allowing foreign companies to dominate opportunities created under the initiative. results.title: Mahama assures businesses of continued fiscal discipline, stable economy
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has assured the private sector that his administration will not abandon the fiscal discipline underpinning Ghana’s economic recovery, pledging to maintain macroeconomic stability to support investment and business expansion.

results.title: Mahama tasks Trade, Transport Ministers to end delays at ports
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has tasked the Ministers of Trade and Transport to address persistent delays in Ghana’s port operations, saying businesses must not spend days clearing containers and moving essential production materials.

results.title: Firefighters save 10 rooms from blaze at Bimbilla chief’s palace
results.content: Firefighters in Bimbilla have prevented a fire at the Kpihibara Naa’s palace at Shirkpamo Fong from spreading to a 10-room compound house.

results.title: Newmont, MTN, Gold Fields lead 2026 Ghana Club 100 rankings
results.content: Newmont Ghana Gold Limited has claimed the top spot in this year’s Ghana Club 100 ranking, beating a field of leading businesses from the banking, telecommunications, mining, manufacturing and other sectors.

results.title: Global Fund for Coral Reefs announces over $30m to protect reefs in 22 developing countries
results.content: The Global Fund for Coral Reefs (GFCR) has announced over US$30 million in new investments and donor contributions to expand coral reef protection across 22 developing countries, as growing climate and human pressures threaten the survival of the ecosystems.

results.title: Police hunt fraudsters sending fake TraffiTech-GH violation messages
results.content: The Ghana Police Service has launched investigations into individuals allegedly impersonating the Service and sending fraudulent TraffiTech-GH traffic violation messages to motorists to defraud them.

results.title: Mahama demands faster port clearance to cut business costs
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has tasked the Ministers of Trade and Industry and Transport to tackle delays at the country’s ports, saying inefficiencies in the movement of goods are eroding the competitiveness of Ghanaian businesses.

results.title: New DNA laboratory to help settle paternity, inheritance disputes – Mahama
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama says the newly commissioned National Human Identification Laboratory will provide scientific answers to family disputes involving paternity, inheritance and the verification of biological relationships.

results.title: Buem Concerned PWDs Association demands answers over Jasikan MCE’s disability donations
results.content: The Concerned PWDs Association in Buem has demanded transparency from the Jasikan Municipal Chief Executive (MCE) over donations made to selected Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) in the municipality on Tuesday, November 17, 2026.
